name: ats-jobs-mcp-server
displayName: Tech & Startup Jobs Scraper (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters)
description: Streamable HTTP MCP server & Apify Actor for extracting normalized tech jobs, salaries, remote roles, and B2B hiring intent signals from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters.

tools.name: search_ats_jobs
tools.description: Search and filter normalized tech/startup jobs across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters.

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: Fetch all active normalized jobs for a single company ATS board.

tools.name: detect_hiring_signals
tools.description: Analyze B2B hiring intent across ATS boards (remote ratio, salary transparency, breakdown by company, department, and seniority).
